rawContent: "If the justice system had worked as it was supposed to, #MeToo might not have existed. #MeToo was always a way of saying that the state and society at large had failed women, that they hadn’t been listened to or protected, and now women had to speak for themselves."
Som jag har längtat efter att samtalet om #metoo ska föras på den här nivån! Välskriven långläsning om hur Sverige framgångsrikt stoppade rörelsen.
